reason: The hypothesis combines the Zr diffusion/bonding mechanism from the VZrHfNbTa coating study (P4, P14) with the reactive-element doping approach for oxidation resistance from the AlCoCrFeNi2.1 studies (P5, P3) and applies them to a new context (bond coats in TBC systems). However, the core idea of using a reactive element (Zr) to form a beneficial interfacial layer and improve oxidation resistance is directly stated or implied in the cited passages, and the application to bond coats is a straightforward extension of existing coating work, lacking a novel mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict between sources.
